paper.title_en: Collective Signatures of Pionic Correlations at High Momentum Transfer
paper.abstract_en: High-momentum-transfer reactions have provided experimental evidence for enhanced pionic correlations in nuclei, yet the microscopic connection between the low-energy pionic response and the delta-hole excitation spectrum remains unresolved. Here we identify hybrid pion-delta collective modes that emerge through the coherent coupling of nucleon-hole and delta-hole excitations. By evaluating the full delta-hole Lindhard function within the random-phase approximation, we find a robust low-energy hybrid pion-delta mode and a higher-energy collective delta-hole mode. The low-energy mode is strongly enhanced as the Landau-Migdal parameter is reduced, exhibiting behavior characteristic of a precursor to pion condensation. We further show that these modes may be probed through high-momentum-transfer charged-pion production reactions. Because the same collective pion-delta function governs both the response and the RPA correlation energy, our results connect experimentally observable collective excitations with microscopic many-body correlations.
